art_instructions: At a child’s eye level, show a cozy wooden bedroom with a low wooden bed filling most of the frame, placed slightly center-left. Owl (small chibi proportions, mottled brown-and-cream feathers, wearing her small green scarf) is tucked under a cream blanket with a soft green stripe, lying on her right side at the right end of the bed with her head on a cream pillow; eyes closed, tiny smile, and one wingtip peeking out above the blanket. A small wooden bedside table to the left of the bed holds a tiny acorn lantern glowing warm golden light; her tiny satchel rests in a woven basket on the floor near the foot of the bed. Behind the bed, a wooden wall and a small window with cream curtains slightly parted reveal a dark blue night sky with a crescent moon and two simple stars. A soft green oval rug sits on the wooden floor, and a small potted fern adds a gentle shape at the far right to balance the scene. Keep forms round and simple with pastel colors, minimal cel-shading (1–2 steps) and faint warm ambient occlusion. The mood is peaceful and still, with clear sticker-like outlines and no text anywhere.
